tabs.overview: A trailer-mounted burner and coil that takes water from the tanks or pit and returns it warm to the suction manifold; run in cold weather so gel hydrates and the blender's lines keep flowing.
tabs.engineering: Sized by the rate and the temperature rise the fluid design needs.
tabs.safety: Open flame on the pad: fuel handling, exhaust and hot surfaces; placed away from the chemical totes and the fuel cube.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).

name: Frac water heater
function: A direct-fired heater that warms the frac water in winter so the fluid hydrates and does not freeze in the lines.
